includes.comment: JNA's bundled native helper, packed at com/sun/jna/<arch>/. Without this entry native-image strips them and Keyring.create() fails with UnsatisfiedLinkError on every platform.

java-keyring 1.0.4 ships its macOS Keychain JNI helper at the JAR root as osxkeychain.so (not under com/github/javakeyring). The static path keeps native-image from stripping it during the resource scan.
